fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: Obedience to scholars has limits
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Taymiyyah** said:

> ***“Ibn Taymiyyah explained that obeying in the permitting of the forbidden and in the forbidding of the permitted can be a dangerous form of following besides Allah.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Scholars are honored, but not deified. No human being may replace Allah’s Ḥalāl and Ḥarām.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Taymiyyah, Majmūʿ al-Fatāwā, Erklärung zur Āyah über Rabbiner und Mönche als Herren neben Allah.
